name: b-talk
description: Welcome to Best Talk! This application empowers users' learning journeys with the best tutors. Our online tutors offer personalized, one-on-one learning to help you improve your grades, build your confidence, and achieve your academic goals.

paragraphs: BestTalk is a front-end showcase for a one-on-one online tutoring platform. Learners browse and filter tutors, view profiles and book lessons; tutors sign up through a multi-step onboarding flow; and students, tutors and admins each get their own dashboard.
It is built with React and Material UI. There is no backend: tutors, conversations and dashboard stats are sample data, and sign-in is mocked (see Demo notes).
features: Landing page: hero, course categories, "Why choose us", free-trial and "become a tutor" calls to action. The layout is responsive, with a drawer menu on mobile.
Tutor search: filter by price range, country, languages spoken, native speakers, "super teachers", available hours and days, and areas of expertise.
Tutor profiles: stats, bio, skills, experience and an intro video, plus a lesson-scheduling dialog with a Stripe card form.
Sign-up flows: learners answer a short goals questionnaire, and tutors complete an 8-step onboarding wizard (education, subjects, expertise, experience, certifications, introduction, availability).
Chat: send text messages, upload images and video, and record voice notes in the browser with the MediaRecorder API.
